user_requested: Apply the lowest available Pearl color calibration to the main style recipe, but do not claim iPhone equivalence before same-scene verification.
source_pair_provenance: Probable Apple and YCam JPEG pair; camera app attribution not authenticated by EXIF
model_transfer_reason: The polynomial fitted only to one white-paper JPEG, extrapolates low/strong colors to nearly white, and is not equivalent to the YCam Core Image LookRecipe pipeline.

shippable_pearl_approximation.kind: constrained neutral-white correction, conservative camera-wide parameters

evidence_for_approximation: Prior photographed white-paper controlled-region offline approximation improved neutral chroma MAE from 1.728% to 0.813%; full RGB MAE 4.237% -> 3.682% on that different heldout protocol. Does not prove sub-1% full image.
